title: Gaomei Wetland－Taichung Tourism
description:
Sunset Stroll on Gaomei Wetland Boardwalk

A gently curving wooden boardwalk winds across the expansive mudflats of Gaomei Wetland, bathed in the warm glow of a setting sun. Visitors pause along the path, taking in the serene vista where shallow pools mirror the sky’s golden hues and distant wind turbines stand sentinel along the horizon.

Gaomei Wetland spans 1,500 acres south of the Dajia River mouth, featuring a mix of sand and soil that supports Taiwan’s largest stand of Bolboschoenus planiculmis. Each fall and winter, migrating birds flock here, drawn by the diverse habitats. The reserve offers amenities such as a service center, parking, restrooms, viewing platforms, trails, and a bus stop, making it an accessible and popular spot for nature enthusiasts and bird-watchers alike.
